dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct rows of high-contrast white spots on a dark ground, visible on the median and greater coverts.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A prominent, rectangular high-contrast region on the nape/upper mantle featuring thick, dark horizontal bars on a white background.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, linear boundary separating the barred nape pattern from the uniform dark grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Bold black-and-white transverse barring on the dorsal neck and upper back region.
